data.story: Develop and validate data migration scripts
data.description: As a developer, I want to develop two migration scripts — one for extracting data from Old PMIS and one for updating data after the old system is switched off — so that data is accurately and completely transferred to e-PMIS
data.acceptanceCriteria:
Given

The workflow mapping and number series decisions have been finalised and the database has been duplicated

When

Both migration scripts are developed and executed in the e-PMIS environment

Then

Script 1 — Data extraction (pre-switch off)

  • The script successfully extracts all relevant data from the Old PMIS system

  • Extracted data is migrated into e-PMIS and displayed on the frontend for validation

  • No data loss or corruption occurs during extraction

Script 2 — Data update (post-switch off)

  • After the Old PMIS is switched off, only verified static data is migrated

  • The script updates the current workflow in e-PMIS with the verified static data

  • No unverified or incomplete records are introduced into the live e-PMIS environment

  • Both scripts are tested and validated before being run against the production dataset

  • Script execution logs are available for audit and troubleshooting
